sloka: दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दाने सुमहत्फलमुच्यते ।भरणे हि भवान् शक्तः सेन्द्राणां मरुतामपि ।। ७.७६.३१ ॥
transliteration: dattasya hi punardāne sumahatphalamucyate ।bharaṇe hi bhavān śaktaḥ sendrāṇāṁ marutāmapi ।। 7.76.31 ॥

translations.english: It is said that giving something again, once it has been given, yields a very great reward, and indeed, you are capable of sustaining even Indra and the Maruts.
